E0129

Distinct-over-distinct: base type is itself a distinct type (D-DIST1)

What

Distinct-over-distinct: base type is itself a distinct type (D-DIST1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0129

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0129: tests/ui/distinct_over_distinct.stderr.

Error [E0129]: `StrongId` can't be built on `UserId` — `UserId` is itself a distinct type
  --> tests/ui/distinct_over_distinct.jet:3:22
    |
  3 | StrongId :: distinct UserId;
    |                      ^^^^^^
 Why: `distinct`-over-`distinct` chaining is not allowed in v1; `UserId` is already a distinct type
 Fix: use `UserId` directly, or build on the shared base type
